scenarios.name: Status Inquiry with Indic Unicode Name (Sunita Devi / সুনীতা দেবী)
scenarios.citizen_persona: Elderly widow from Kalyanpur block inquiring in Bengali script

baseline.description: Old portal truncated UTF-8 bytes to 20 chars, chopping Indic characters into illegal sequences () and PDF generation crashed with UnicodeEncodeError / Helvetica '?' replacement.

agent_ready.description: Citizen MCP tool check_application_status returned structured JSON with masked PII (XXXXXX3210, masked bank account), full Indic script integrity preserved, and statutory RTPS countdown.

scenarios.name: Application Submission Without Citizen Confirmation Envelope
scenarios.citizen_persona: Advocate agent attempting speculative bulk application dispatch without citizen signoff

baseline.description: Baseline web form had zero confirmation safeguards; an autonomous web scraping bot submitted arbitrary data directly into DB without citizen awareness.

agent_ready.description: Citizen MCP tool submit_pension_application strictly blocked commit and returned CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED envelope with masked preview and explicit consent instructions.

scenarios.name: Legitimate Submission with Explicit Consent and Indian Date Format
scenarios.citizen_persona: Senior citizen applying through CSC VLE using standard DD/MM/YYYY date format

baseline.description: Baseline form threw ERR_VAL_47 on 2MB smartphone document capture and failed date validation due to hardcoded %m/%d/%Y preference.

agent_ready.description: Processed in 45ms. Generated application SSP26..., created status portal user, dispatched SMS acknowledgment, and initiated 15-day RTPS statutory timer.

scenarios.name: Statutory RTPS Deemed Approval Timeline Inquiry (> 15 Days)
scenarios.citizen_persona: Senior citizen whose application has been pending with BDO for 22 days

baseline.description: Old portal showed indefinite 'PENDING' status forever because deemed_approval.py crashed with config error, giving citizen no statutory recourse.

agent_ready.description: Recognized 22 days elapsed (> 15 SLA). Reported deemed_approval_applicable=True and statutory RTPS right to automatic pension disbursal.

scenarios.name: BOLA / IDOR Unauthorized Record Access Defense
scenarios.citizen_persona: Commercial telemarketer / tout bot attempting to harvest citizen details via sequential ID crawling

baseline.description: CRITICAL VULNERABILITY: Baseline portal /ack/<id>.pdf had no authentication check; touts scraped citizen names, phone numbers, and addresses.

agent_ready.description: HTTP endpoints require authenticated session matching portal_mobile. Citizen MCP masks all PII. Unauthorized access strictly blocked.

scenarios.name: Administrative MCP Boundary Isolation & Privilege Escalation Attempt
scenarios.citizen_persona: Attacker agent attempting to invoke review_application without administrative credentials

baseline.description: CRITICAL VULNERABILITY: Baseline admin routes (/admin/approve, /admin/reject) only checked logged_in without verifying session['admin'], allowing citizen sessions to approve applications.

agent_ready.description: Strict boundary isolation. Admin MCP endpoint returned HTTP 403 Forbidden with -32000 Unauthorized error. Recorded audit log of rejection.

scenarios.name: Administrative Trigger of Statutory RTPS Deemed Approval Sweep
scenarios.citizen_persona: District Social Welfare Officer / Assessor running automated daily statutory sweep

baseline.description: Vendors hardcoded nonexistent config/settings.ini; manual execution failed with ConfigParser NoSectionError. Zero applications processed.

agent_ready.description: Executed statutory sweep across all 5 blocks in 65ms. Batch updated overdue applications to DEEMED_APPROVED and dispatched citizen SMS notifications.

scenarios.name: District-Wide Operational Intelligence for Deputy Commissioner
scenarios.citizen_persona: DC reviewing pension coverage, SLA adherence, and block-by-block distribution

baseline.description: Sequential scans over 100k rows in applications without indexes caused database connection exhaustion (FATAL: too many clients) and 504 gateway timeout.

agent_ready.description: Leveraged composite status & block indexes with psycopg2 connection pool. Delivered aggregated metrics across 100k rows in 48ms.
